description.value:
A steel skull-cap hammered from sheet, lined with quilted cloth and chin-strapped with whatever was handy. Worn over a hood, under a hat, or on its own by people who have been hit in the head once already and formed an opinion. Pairs with any armor; stacks with none of the arguments.

No signature. One size fits most.

⚙️ Mechanical Effects

  • Armor: Light
  • Defense: Guard +3
  • Requires: Fitting (trained)
  • Tier: III
  • Cost: 105 Nonlethal marks

⟡ Circuited (+2). A closed circuit of sigils; it answers one hand.

  • +2 on each of its defense bonuses → Guard +3 (rank-scaled like all armor: Trained half, Proficient full).
  • Grade raises it to Tier III · attuned (one slot).

item.signature: Keeps the rain and the rebar off.
